purpose: Small-scale end-to-end functionality validation; scores are not paper-scale estimates
hardware: Four NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPUs; visibility was configured per run alongside concurrent workloads

device_mapping.frozen_qwen2_vl: Hugging Face device_map=auto across visible CUDA devices

runs.scope: Three members, one adapter update each; native visual fusion
commands: for member in member0 member1 member2; do pacr train-full --data-root "$DATA_ROOT" --cohort development --member "$member" --qwen3-model "$QWEN3" --smoke-per-class 2 --smoke-queries-per-class 1 --max-updates 1 --output "outputs/validation/full/$member"; done
pacr fuse-full --members outputs/validation/full/member0 outputs/validation/full/member1 outputs/validation/full/member2 --output outputs/validation/full/fused.npz
